nodes.statement: ∀ {d n k : ℕ} (g : Geometry d n), k ≤ fieldSize d n → Function.Injective (alpha g : Fin k → g.F)
nodes.proof_route: All Fin k values satisfy alpha branch condition. Apply injectivity of public field enumeration g.elements, then take underlying natural values.

nodes.statement: ∀ {d n k : ℕ} (g : Geometry d n), k ≤ fieldSize d n → ∀ layers : Fin d ↪ Fin k, Function.Injective (fun z : Fin d → g.F => fun j : Fin d => fixedForm g (layers j) z)
nodes.proof_route: Distinct layers and alpha injectivity give distinct Vandermonde row parameters. Mathlib Matrix.det_vandermonde_ne_zero_iff and Matrix.mulVec_injective_of_det_ne_zero prove injectivity; fixedForm is definitionally this matrix-vector product.

nodes.statement: ∀ g hk layers {z z' : Fin d → g.F}, (∀ j, fixedForm g (layers j) z = fixedForm g (layers j) z') → z = z'
z ∈ activePointSet g A → ∃ layers : Fin d ↪ Fin k, ∀ j, (layers j, fixedForm g (layers j) z) ∈ A
nodes.proof_route: Fintype card Fin d equals d; Function.Embedding.exists_of_card_le_finset embeds d indices into activeLayers g A z.

nodes.statement: ∀ {d n k : ℕ} (g : Geometry d n), k ≤ fieldSize d n → ∀ A : Finset (Fin k × g.F), (activePointSet g A).card ≤ A.card ^ d
nodes.proof_route: Choose d distinct active layers per candidate z. Encode z by Fin d → A of the corresponding active pairs. Equal encodings give equal layer indices and fixedForm values, so Vandermonde uniqueness makes this encoding injective. Compare Fintype cards.
